fee_notes: Minimum Initial Franchise Fee is $35,000 at signing, covering one Protected Area (one or several US postal zip codes). A higher fee may be charged based on size of Protected Area, number of locations, market potential, population base, character of residential properties, and total market turn-over. An additional $5,000 fee may apply if the right to open an additional physical location within the Protected Area is granted. In 2024, Initial Franchise Fees paid ranged from $0 to $35,000. The fee is non-refundable. Note: the $0 low end reflects actual 2024 payments disclosed; the schema low/high reflects the stated contractual minimum of $35,000.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") at a minimum amount of $35,000 at the time of signing the Franchise Agreement. For the minimum Initial Franchise Fee, your Protected Area will be an area of one or several US postal zip codes. You may be charged a higher Initial Franchise Fee based on the size of your Protected Area, the number of locations, the market potential, the population base, the character of its residential properties and the total market turn-over. This may include a $5,000 Initial Franchise Fee, should we grant you the right to to open and operate an additional physcial location within your Protected Area... In 2024, the Initial Franchise Fees paid ranged from $0 to $35,000.
